$comment: An attachment as Resend returns one, from the API reference's example on 2026-09-15. The id is BOUND to the attachmentId that was asked for, so a flow that reads an id off the trigger and passes it here sees it echoed, as a real read does. The download URL is a literal: the vocabulary has no concatenation, and the shape -- a signed CDN URL with an expiry beside it -- is what an author designs against.
